nodes.name: slackTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow on Slack events: messages, mentions, reactions, new channels and members, shared files, …
nodes.subtitle: {{events}}

options.name: Access Token
options.description: A bot token pasted from the Slack app

options.name: OAuth2
options.description: Connect with Slack; the token is renewed for you

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Slack has no API to register an Events subscription. Publish the workflow, copy this node's Request URL from the editor's Publish menu (App webhooks) into the Slack app's Event Subscriptions page (Enable Events), and subscribe to the bot events you picked below. The credential's Signing Secret ("Basic Information" page) is required: Landflow verifies every call with it and answers Slack's URL verification.

properties.name: events

options.name: Any Event
options.description: Every event the Slack app is subscribed to

options.name: App Home Opened
options.description: A user opened the app's Home or Messages tab

options.name: App Mention
options.description: The app was @mentioned in a channel it is in

options.name: Link Shared
options.description: A link of a domain the app unfurls was posted

options.name: Message
options.description: A message in any channel, group or DM the app can see (subscribe to the message.* events)

options.name: Team Join
options.description: A new member joined the workspace

options.name: User Change
options.description: A member's profile changed

properties.description: The event types that start a run. Choosing Message and App Mention starts two runs for a mention in a channel.

properties.name: watchWorkspace
properties.description: Whether events of every channel the app can see start a run; turn it off to limit them to the channels below

properties.name: channelIds
properties.description: Channel IDs, comma-separated (the channel's "Copy channel ID"). Events without a channel (new members, profile changes) do not match.

properties.name: ignoreBots
properties.description: Whether to skip events written by bots or integrations (bot_id, subtype bot_message) and by this app itself, so a workflow that replies cannot trigger itself

properties.name: ignoreEdits
properties.description: Whether to skip message events of subtype message_changed and message_deleted

values.name: tolerance
values.description: How far the signed request timestamp may be from now before the call is rejected as a replay

credentialTypes.name: slackOAuth2Api
credentialTypes.description: Sign in with Slack: create an app at api.slack.com/apps, add the redirect URL shown below under OAuth & Permissions, add the bot scopes, then Connect. The bot token is renewed for you when token rotation is on. For the Slack Trigger also fill in the Signing Secret, publish the workflow and paste the node's Request URL (editor Publish menu, App webhooks: {public URL}/api/webhook/app/<workflow id>/<node id>) into Event Subscriptions, then subscribe to the bot events and add the matching scopes (app_mentions:read, channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history, reactions:read, files:read, …). Reinstall the app after changing scopes.
